rules.description: Asserts data reaches 2024 with >= 690 StatVars reaching 2024.

params.query: SELECT CAST(MAX(MaxDate) AS INTEGER) AS latest_year, COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS total_svs, SUM(CASE WHEN MaxDate >= '2024' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fresh_svs FROM stats

rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records is within 0.1% threshold.
